props.title: Run Your Own SG/Send Server
props.subtitle: Zero-knowledge encrypted vaults, on your infrastructure — Docker, AWS, GCP, Heroku, or a static host

items.title: Docker
items.description: One command, runs anywhere. The fastest path to a working server — available today.

items.title: AWS Lambda
items.description: Serverless, one-click CloudFormation stack. Pay-per-request, scales to zero.

items.title: AWS EC2 Appliance
items.description: A dedicated instance from the SG/Send AMI, with your own domain and auto-TLS.

items.title: AWS ECS / Fargate
items.description: Long-running, multi-replica cluster behind a load balancer. One stack, full lifecycle.

items.title: GCP Cloud Run
items.description: The same container on Google Cloud — deploy with one gcloud command or a button.

items.title: Heroku
items.description: Container deployment via the Heroku registry or a Deploy button.

items.title: Static Hosting
items.description: Publish a read-only vault projection to GitHub Pages, S3, Netlify, and more.
